## HaloBar 0.0.3

### New
- **Every screen.** Put the dock on the screen you choose, or one on every screen, each keeping its own space. Settings → **Screens**.
- **Shared with Astraeus.** Do Not Disturb is one switch for both apps, and while Astraeus runs, your notifications drop from Astraeus instead of the dock. The theme that follows Astraeus is now called **Astraeus**.
- **Clipboard history keeps images**, with a small preview; click one to copy it again.
- **Apps as one block.** In edit mode the whole group of apps moves like a widget, so widgets can sit before it. Apps that don't fit wait behind a **+N** tile.
- **Your own dividers**, as many as you like, from the gallery.
- **Go back to Windows taskbar** in settings: HaloBar waits in the tray with a little dashboard to bring it back. **Check for updates** is there too.
- **Settings scroll**, with room for the new cards.

### Fixes
- **Windows keeps your notifications again.** HaloBar used to hide Windows' banners with a switch that also stopped Windows from storing notifications at all. It now hides only each app's banner, and puts everything back exactly as it was when it exits.
- **Show desktop works.**
- **System stats keep updating** instead of stopping after the first reading.
- **Pause from the dock** pauses instead of opening the player; widget × buttons, toggles and mute respond on the first click.
- **Edit mode no longer closes** when the mouse leaves the dock on its way to the gallery.
- Pinned apps have more room between them.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
